name: I-meningitis
tagline: Intamo eqinile, ikhanda elibuhlungu, ukuqubuka okunsomi.

urgent.heading: Kuyaphuthuma — hamba uye esibhedlela manje
urgent.primary_message: I-bacterial meningitis ingabulala emahoreni ambalwa. Ungalindi zonke izimpawu - phuthuma esibhedlela.
red_flags: Ukuqubuka okunsomi-obomvu AKUBUYI lapho ucindezelwa ngaphansi kwengilazi
Intamo eqinile — ayikwazi ukuthinta isilevu esifubeni
Indawo ethambile evuvukele ekhanda lomntwana, enomkhuhlane kanye nokwenqaba ukuncelisa

what_is_it.heading: I-meningitis ngamazwi alula
what_is_it.lede: I-Meningitis ukutheleleka kwe-meninges - izingqimba ezivikelayo ezizungeze ubuchopho nomgogodla. I-bacterial meningitis ingesinye sezifo ezibulala ngokushesha ezaziwayo.
paragraphs: Iningi le-meningitis libangelwa igciwane noma ibhaktheriya. I-Viral meningitis imvamisa ithambile futhi iba ngcono iyodwa. I-bacterial meningitis iyisimo esiphuthumayo sangempela - ingabulala umuntu onempilo emahoreni ambalwa futhi idinga ama-antibiotics ngokushesha.

Ngaphandle, awukwazi ukwehlukanisa ngokuthembekile laba bobabili. Kungakho wonke amacala asolwayo kufanele aphathwe njengebhaktheriya kuze kutholakale ubufakazi obuhlukile. INingizimu Afrika iqhuba izinhlelo zokugoma ezifweni eziyingozi kakhulu.

items.headline: Ibulala ngamahora
items.body: I-bacterial meningitis ingasuka esibonakalisweni sokuqala iye ekufeni esikhathini esingaphansi kwamahora angu-24. Ijubane lokwelashwa liyikho konke.

items.headline: Umgomo-uvikeleke
items.body: Imithi yokugoma yamahhala ye-SA yezingane (Hib, Pneumococcal, Meningococcal) ivimbela izinhlobo eziyingozi kakhulu. Zithole ngesikhathi.

items.headline: Vala ingcuphe yokuxhumana
items.body: Kusabaleleka ngokukhwehlela, ukuthimula, ukuqabulana, noma ukwabelana ngeziphuzo. Abasondelene nabo banganikezwa ama-antibiotic njengesinyathelo sokuzivikela.

items.headline: Ukuhlolwa kwe-tumbler
items.body: Cindezela ingilazi ecacile ngokumelene nokuqubuka. Uma amabala engabuni ngaphansi kwengcindezi - phuthuma esibhedlela.

pull_quote.text: Themba umzwelo wakho. Uma okuthile kuzwakala kungalungile kakhulu - ikakhulukazi enganeni - ungalindi isethi egcwele yezimpawu. Hamba esibhedlela. I-Meningitis ingabulala ngaphambi kokuba kuvele zonke izimpawu.

signs.heading: Ongakubuka
signs.lede: Izimpawu zingaqala njengomkhuhlane, bese ziba zimbi ngokushesha. Izimpawu zakudala zingase zingaveli ngokulandelana okufanayo - noma ezinganeni nasezinganeni ezincane.

items.title: Abantu abadala kanye nezingane ezindala
items.description: Ukushisa okuphezulu, ikhanda elibuhlungu elibuhlungu, intamo eqinile (ayikwazi ukuthinta isilevu esifubeni), ukuzwela okuncane, isicanucanu noma ukuhlanza, ukudideka noma ukozela.

items.title: Umqubuko onsomi
items.description: Amachashaza amancane abomvu-nsomi noma amabala abukeka njengemivimbo. Isakazeka ngokushesha. Ayipheli lapho icindezelwa ngengilazi — lokhu kuyisimo esiphuthumayo.

items.title: Izingane ezisacathula
items.description: Ukukhala kokububula okuphakeme, ukwenqaba ukudla, ukuphaphatheka kakhulu noma ukuqina kakhulu, indawo ethambile eqhumayo, isikhumba esinamabala noma esiphaphathekile, umkhuhlane wezandla nezinyawo ezibandayo.

items.title: Amaphethelo abandayo kuqala
items.description: Izandla nezinyawo kubanda ngesikhathi umzimba ushisa, ubuhlungu obukhulu emlenzeni, kanye nesikhumba esiphaphathekile ngendlela engavamile kungaba izimpawu zangaphambili kunokuqubuka noma ukuqina kwentamo.

spreads.heading: Indlela i-meningitis esakazeka ngayo
yes: Ukwabelana ngezinkomishi, amabhodlela amanzi, ugwayi, noma izinto zokusika
Ukuhlala ezindaweni eziseduze - izindawo zokuhlala zasenyuvesi, izindlu zamasosha, amajele
no: Ukuxhumana okuvamile njengokuxhawulana noma ukuba segumbini elilodwa
Izihlalo zangasese, amachibi okubhukuda, noma izibambo zeminyango

prevention.heading: Ungazivikela kanjani wena nomndeni wakho
prevention.lede: Imithi yokugoma ivikela ezinhlotsheni eziyingozi kakhulu ze-meningitis yebhaktheriya. Zimahhala kuyo yonke imitholampilo kahulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika yezingane, futhi zinconyelwe abantu abadala abasengcupheni ephezulu.

items.title: Imithi yokugoma yamahhala yezingane
items.description: Hib at 6, 10, 14 amasonto. I-pneumococcal emavikini ayisi-6, amasonto ayi-14, izinyanga eziyi-9. I-Meningococcal lapho kuboniswe khona. Landela uhlelo lwe-SA.

items.title: Amaqembu anobungozi obukhulu
items.description: Abafundi basenyuvesi abasezindaweni zokuhlala, ababuthiwe, abavakashela ibhande le-meningitis yase-Afrika noma i-Hajj - buza udokotela wakho mayelana nomuthi wokugomela i-Meningococcal ACWY.

items.title: Uma osondelene naye egula
items.description: Amalungu omndeni kanye nabasondelene nabo be-bacterial meningitis ngokuvamile banikezwa ama-antibiotics okuvimbela yi-Public Health. Zithathe - ziyasebenza.

items.title: Bona kusenesikhathi — thatha isinyathelo ngokushesha
items.description: Ukwazi izimpawu kusindisa izimpilo. Themba umzwelo wakho. Uma kukhona okungahambi kahle, phuthuma esibhedlela.

items.fact: Izingane, intsha, kanye nabantu abadala abasebasha basengozini enkulu, kodwa ingahlasela kunoma ibuphi ubudala. Ukuqubuka kwezindawo zokuhlala zentsha nasemanyuvesi kuvamile.

items.myth: Uma ukuqubuka kusaphela lapho ngicindezela, akusona i-meningitis.
items.fact: Ekuqaleni kwe-meningitis ukuqubuka kusengaphela. Uma kukhona ezinye izimpawu - ikhanda elibuhlungu, imfiva, ukuqina kwentamo - hamba esibhedlela kungakhathaliseki ukuthi yini.
I-bacterial meningitis idinga ama-antibiotics emithanjeni esibhedlela, kanye nokuqapha. Ama-antibiotic ethebhulethi kuphela awanele.
Imithi yokugoma ivikela izimbangela zamabhaktheriya ezivame kakhulu. Azibangeli lesi sifo. Imithi yokugoma yeshejuli yezingane iphephile futhi isindisa impilo.

items.title: Yenza ukuhlolwa kwe-tumbler
items.description: Cindezela uhlangothi lwengilazi ecacile ngokuqinile ngokumelene nokuqubuka. Uma amabala ehlala ebonakala engilazini - hamba uye esibhedlela manje.

items.title: Shayela ku-10177 noma uye ngqo egumbini lezimo eziphuthumayo
items.description: Ithi 'i-meningitis esolwayo' lapho ugijima ukuze ubonakale ngokushesha. Ungalindi isikhathi sokubonana nodokotela.

items.title: Qaphela ukuthi izimpawu zaqala nini
items.description: Isikhathi sibalulekile. Tshela ithimba lesibhedlela lapho umkhuhlane, ikhanda elibuhlungu, ukuqubuka, noma ukuguquka kokuziphatha kwaqala.

items.title: Ungalindi zonke izimpawu
items.description: I-triad yakudala yemfiva, ukuqina kwentamo, kanye nekhanda elibuhlungu kungase kungaveli konke ndawonye. Ngayinye iyodwa iyisizathu sokuhlolwa.

items.title: Tshela oxhumana nabo abaseduze
items.description: Noma ubani owake wabelana nomndeni, inkomishi, noma ukuqabulana ngesonto eledlule kufanele axhumane nePublic Health ukuze athole iseluleko. I-antibiotic prophylaxis ingase inikezwe.

get_help.heading: Ubani okumele ashayele khona manje
get_help.lede: I-meningitis yebhaktheriya okusolakala ukuthi ingesinye sezifo ezimbalwa lapho 'ukuya esibhedlela manje' kuyimpendulo efanele - ngisho nango-3am, ngisho noma ungenaso isiqiniseko.

helplines.description: Ifinyelela kunoma iyiphi isevisi yezimo eziphuthumayo ngomakhalekhukhwini
